mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 70 degrees and an air quality index of 55.
The city is currently working with AECOM for ongoing engineering services. Residents can also enjoy the tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center or apply for seasonal recreation positions.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Later this evening, enjoy Concerts in the Park and Hop Haus trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market this Saturday.
Regarding the weekly report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a driver for an O W I and suspended vehicle registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM.
